name: preflight-absent-path-prose
title: The documentation path-reference check cannot express a deliberately absent path
description: The documentation path-reference check fails a PRD/spec that names a nonexistent path in a Markdown link or a code span — the only two reference kinds it extracts — with no per-file or per-line way to mark an intentional absence. The only escape is the repo-global optionalReferencePaths list, which would also mask genuine rot. design.md/implement.md are already excluded on the premise that PRDs describe current state; a PRD describing an absent file breaks that premise. main is red today from two such false positives, one naming a file the same sentence says is not in this repository. This task's own PRD had to drop backticks around that path to pass.
creator: sdelmas
